_note: Studio page FAQs. Answers about terms come from Membership Agreement v2.0 and Fee Schedule v2.0. Keep them matching the contract. Minimum terms updated by Lauren 6 Nov 2026 (Premium 3 months, others 6 months): the agreement needs to match.

items.q: I've never lifted before. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. Every strength class is coached, so a coach can see your form and adjust your weights. Premium also includes our beginner workshops, where we go through the main lifts step by step before you do them in class.

items.q: I've just had a baby. Can I come?
items.a: Yes. Mums and bubs classes follow the same structure as our strength classes, and bub comes with you. There's a play pen within view, and prams stay in the waiting area. Before you start, everyone fills in a pre-exercise screening. If something in your answers needs it, we may ask for clearance from your doctor first.
Yes. Every class and open gym session at FIT X Studio is for women only, including Saturday HIIT.

It's two weeks of unlimited classes for $89, bought on Mindbody. If you stay on as a Premium member ($75 a week, paid Mondays), those two weeks count towards your minimum term. There's no joining fee.

Yes. Premium has a 3-month minimum term. Strength, Pilates and Open Gym memberships have a 6-month minimum term. Your fee won't go up during it. After that your membership keeps going at the same rate until you cancel with 28 days' written notice (email is fine). You also have 3 business days to cool off after signing.

items.q: What if I need to stop during my minimum term?
items.a: If you move more than 100km away, interstate or overseas, or become permanently unable to train, there's no exit fee. You can also transfer your membership to someone else for $30. Otherwise the early exit fee is $200 or four weeks' fees, whichever is less.
Yes, for 1 to 8 weeks in any 12 months with 14 days' notice. It's $5 a week while you're on hold, or free with a medical certificate.
Through Mindbody. Classes open two weeks ahead and you can cancel free of charge up to 12 hours before. Premium members get first offer of waitlist spots.
A water bottle, a towel and enclosed training shoes. For mat Pilates you'll need grip socks, which you can bring or buy from us.

items.q: How old do I need to be?
items.a: 16 or over. If you're 16 or 17, a parent or guardian signs your agreement with you.
